title: Repository Guidelines
text: R client lives repo root; exported APIs sit R/*.R, config/caching helpers R/config.R R/cache.R, package metadata DESCRIPTION/NAMESPACE. Bundled cache skeletons live inst/extdata keep tests offline. R tests use testthat tests/testthat/test_*.R. Python client resides python-client/templateflow; CLI entrypoint templateflow/cli.py, docs live python-client/docs, tests sit python-client/templateflow/tests. python-client/pyproject.toml stores lint/format/test settings; update CHANGES.rst altering Python-facing behavior.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: R package: R CMD build . create tarball, R CMD check templateflow_*.tar.gz full checks, R -q -e "testthat::test_dir('tests/testthat')" quick pass. Python (run python-client/):
code: python -m pip install -e .[tests] python -m pytest templateflow/tests          # unit tests python -m ruff check templateflow            # lint (line length 99, single quotes) python -m black --check templateflow         # format gate

title: Repository Guidelines
text: R: two-space indent; braces line; snake_case objects; exported functions use tf_* prefix. Add roxygen2 comments changing APIs NAMESPACE stays sync. Python: Black formatting (line length 99, single quotes), isort-aligned imports, Ruff lint rules pyproject.toml (E/W/F//BLE/etc.). Use snake_case functions/modules, PascalCase classes, uppercase constants.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Keep R tests self-contained tempdir() caches existing specs; avoid hitting public S3 bucket reusing bundled skeletons inst/extdata. Python tests belong templateflow/tests follow test_*.py naming. Prefer fixtures temp dirs cache paths; run coverage python -m pytest --cov templateflow. touching CLI, assert exit codes stdout/stderr text.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Recent history favors concise, imperative messages prefixes fix:, feat:, rel(<version>):; follow style keep commit focused. PRs include short summary, linked issues motivation, notes cache/data implications, evidence tests run (R Python). Add doc preview links screenshots changing user-facing docs CLI output.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Default cache root ~/.cache/templateflow; override TEMPLATEFLOW_HOME=/path//cache. Disable automatic updates debugging TEMPLATEFLOW_AUTOUPDATE=0; keep timeouts reasonable per R/config.R.

title: Getting started with templateflow
text: Neuroimaging analyses almost always need reference brain template – MNI152 T1w image, atlas parcellation, surface mesh. TemplateFlow archive collects resources single, version-controlled repository consistent BIDS naming. templateflow R package gives direct access archive without leaving R. dependency Python reticulate – files fetched demand public S3 bucket cached locally.
code: library(templateflow)  # one line to get the MNI152 1 mm T1w image path <- tf_get(template = "MNI152Lin", resolution = 1, suffix = "T1w")

title: Getting started with templateflow
text: Install development version GitHub: reading NIfTI files directly R, also want one optional neuroimaging packages:
code: install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("bbuchsbaum/templateflow") install.packages("RNifti")   # lightweight NIfTI reader (recommended) # or install.packages("oro.nifti") # alternative NIfTI reader install.packages("gifti")     # for GIFTI surface files

title: Getting started with templateflow
text: Load package see templates available: first call initialises local cache (default ~/.cache/templateflow) downloads lightweight skeleton listing every file archive. Subsequent calls reuse cache instantly. First run. tf_ls() tf_get() raises error mentioning “cache appears empty,” skeleton failed populate (often transient network issue). Run tf_cache_update() fetch explicitly, set TEMPLATEFLOW_HOME point existing cache already skeleton. see specific template offers — citations BIDS entity values can filter — use tf_describe():
code: library(templateflow)  tf_templates() #> [1] "Fischer344"        "MNI152Lin"         "MNI152NLin2009cAsym" #> [4] "MNI152NLin2009cSym" "MNI152NLin6Asym"  "MNI152NLin6Sym" #> [7] "MNIInfant"         "MNIPediatricAsym"  "NKI" #> ... tf_describe("MNI152Lin") #> <TemplateFlow description: MNI152Lin> #>   Name: MNI ICBM 152 linear #>   References: 1 entry(ies) #>     - http://nist.mni.mcgill.ca/?p=858 #> #>   Entities present: #>     desc       : brain, head, ... #>     resolution : 1, 2 #>     suffix     : T1w, T2w, mask, probseg, ...

title: Getting started with templateflow
text: Use tf_ls() see files template contains. can filter BIDS entity – resolution, suffix, atlas, desc, extension, : see results structured data frame instead file paths, pass as_df = TRUE: can check entity names available filtering, either globally specific template:
code: # all files for MNI152Lin tf_ls(template = "MNI152Lin")  # only the 1 mm T1w image tf_ls(template = "MNI152Lin", resolution = 1, suffix = "T1w") tf_ls(template = "MNI152Lin", as_df = TRUE) #> # A tibble: 18 x 9 #>    path                template   resolution suffix extension ... # all entity names recognised by templateflow tf_entities() #>  [1] "atlas"     "cohort"    "density"   "desc"      "extension" #>  [6] "hemi"      "label"     "resolution" "roi"      "scale" #> [11] "segmentation" "space"  "suffix"    "template"  # only entities present for this template tf_entities(template = "MNI152Lin") #> [1] "desc" "extension" "resolution" "suffix"  # unique values per entity (great for figuring out e.g. which `desc` to use) tf_entities(template = "MNI152Lin", values = TRUE)$desc #> [1] "brain" "head"

title: Getting started with templateflow
text: tf_get() works like tf_ls() also downloads files yet cached locally. returns local file path(s): progress bar appears multiple files downloaded. default tf_get() raises error query matches files (raise_empty = TRUE). Pass raise_empty = FALSE rather get back empty character vector queries can legitimately return zero results. get copy files directory choosing (handy shipping templates alongside project), pass dest: cache remains canonical store; dest receives snapshot copy preserving BIDS sub-path.
code: # download (if needed) and return the local path path <- tf_get(template = "MNI152Lin", resolution = 1, suffix = "T1w") path #> [1] "/Users/you/.cache/templateflow/tpl-MNI152Lin/tpl-MNI152Lin_res-01_T1w.nii.gz" tf_get(   template = "MNI152Lin",   resolution = 1,   suffix = "T1w",   dest = "./templates" ) #> [1] "./templates/tpl-MNI152Lin/tpl-MNI152Lin_res-01_T1w.nii.gz"

title: Getting started with templateflow
text: Pass read = TRUE load file R object automatically. NIfTI files read RNifti (oro.nifti), GIFTI gifti, JSON TSV standard readers:
code: img <- tf_get(   template = "MNI152Lin",   resolution = 1,   suffix = "T1w",   read = TRUE )  img #> Image array of mode "double" (182 x 218 x 182) #> - voxel dimensions: 1 x 1 x 1 mm

title: Getting started with templateflow
text: Every template ships template_description.json file containing name, species, reference space, citation links. can access tf_get_metadata(): citation information, tf_get_citations() returns reference URLs , bibtex = TRUE, BibTeX entries can paste directly bibliography:
code: meta <- tf_get_metadata(template = "MNI152NLin2009cAsym") meta$Name #> [1] "MNI152NLin2009cAsym"  meta$Species #> [1] "Homo sapiens" tf_get_citations(template = "MNI152NLin2009cAsym") #> [1] "https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2010.07.033"  tf_get_citations(template = "MNI152NLin2009cAsym", bibtex = TRUE)

title: Getting started with templateflow
text: need create pass client object explicitly. tf_*() functions use default global client behind scenes. want customise settings (e.g. non-default cache location), create client set global default:
code: client <- TemplateFlowClient(root = "/data/templates") tf_set_client(client)  # all subsequent calls use /data/templates as the cache tf_templates()

title: Getting started with templateflow
text: local cache can inspected maintained helpers:
code: # how big is the cache? tf_cache_stats() #> $cache_files #> [1] 2847 #> $cache_size_human #> [1] "1.2 GB"  # check for problems (zero-byte stubs, corrupted downloads) tf_cache_scan()  # re-sync the skeleton from upstream tf_cache_update()  # rebuild the file index without downloading anything tf_cache_refresh()  # nuclear option: delete everything and start fresh tf_cache_wipe()

title: templateflow 0.1.0
text: Cache directory now uses platform-appropriate location via rappdirs: macOS ~/Library/Caches/templateflow, Windows AppData/Local. Set TEMPLATEFLOW_HOME override.

title: templateflow 0.1.0
text: Custom error conditions (templateflow_error, templateflow_network_error, templateflow_not_found, templateflow_invalid_filter, templateflow_cache_error) structured error handling tryCatch(). Migrated HTTP backend httr httr2 automatic retry exponential backoff transient failures. Atomic file writes prevent partial/corrupt downloads. Config-driven layout parsing config.json instead hardcoded entities. tf_ls() gains as_df parameter return results data frame. tf_get() gains read parameter return neuroimaging objects directly using RNifti, oro.nifti, gifti available. tf_prefetch() batch-downloads zero-byte skeleton stubs. tf_cache_stats(), tf_cache_scan(), tf_cache_refresh() cache utilities. Fuzzy entity name matching suggestions typos. Full CLI rewrite 9 subcommands: config, ls, get, wipe, update, meta, cite, refresh, doctor. DataLad backend support via TEMPLATEFLOW_USE_DATALAD environment variable. Neuroimaging file reader dispatch (tf_read_file()) NIfTI, GIFTI, JSON, TSV.
